column1: # Godot presentation settings and event feedback.
Visible vehicles and combat leave ground marks. Saved with the battle; requires Ground detail.
column2: 可见车辆和战斗会留下地面痕迹，随战局存档保存；需开启地面细节。

column1: Soft rectangular lights around visible bases. Uses extra GPU time.
column2: 在可见基地周围呈现柔和的矩形灯光，会增加显卡负载。

column1: SDR active · HDR requires a supported display and system settings.
column2: 当前为 SDR · HDR 需要兼容的显示器和系统设置。

column1: Auto uses the display rating. Override only if bright details disappear. Available on Windows and macOS.
column2: 自动模式使用显示器标称亮度。仅在亮部细节丢失时调整。支持 Windows 和 macOS。

column1: Auto follows system brightness. Manual adjustment is available on Windows; other platforms use system brightness.
column2: 自动模式跟随系统亮度。Windows 支持手动调整；其他平台使用系统亮度。

column1: Keep the dark patches distinct and bright patches separated. Use Auto first; adjust your display brightness on macOS.
column2: 确保暗色色块清晰、亮色色块可区分。优先使用自动模式；macOS 请调整显示器亮度。

column1: HDR calibration: dark tones, paper white, bright highlights.
column2: HDR 校准：暗部、纸白和高亮。

column1: SDR active · enable HDR output to use this display's HDR range.
column2: 当前为 SDR · 开启 HDR 输出以使用此显示器的 HDR 亮度范围。

column1: 8192×8192 shadow atlas, Ultra soft shadow filtering, shadowed base lights, high-resolution volumetric fog, and maximum mesh detail.
column2: 8192×8192 阴影贴图、极致柔化阴影过滤、带阴影基地灯光、高分辨率体积雾与最高模型细节。

column1: Hardware multi-bounce indirect light and sky occlusion on RTX GPUs; uses 3D SDFGI on other Forward+ GPUs.
column2: 在 RTX 显卡上启用硬件多反弹间接光照与天空遮蔽；其他 Forward+ 显卡自动回退为 3D SDFGI。

column1: Real-time reflections on water, wet pavement, and metallic armor. Uses hardware ray tracing when supported, falling back to full-res SSR.
column2: 水面、湿润路面与金属装甲的实时反射。支持时启用硬件光线追踪，否则回退为全分辨率 SSR。

column1: Internal ray tracing resolution for RTGI and Raytraced reflections.
column2: RTGI 与光追反射的内部追踪分辨率。

column1: AgX preserves rich color and highlight detail in bright sunlight and explosions.
column2: AgX 可在强光与爆炸中保留丰富的色彩与高光层次。
